text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ has made dramatic
improvements
ever since summer camp.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She has always been an imposing figure
to Narita
Taishin, ever since they ran a
race together as
children.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит is still eager to win,
undaunted by
Biwa Hayahide, which
sends Нарита Таисин into a
panic.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The fear of being left behind pushes
Narita
Taishin to act recklessly. In her
impatience, she
ends up damaging her
health.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин tearfully begs to run in
the Kikuka
Sho because racing and
winning are all that she
has.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I'm unable to deny her wish—not when
her pleas
are so heartrending.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
